selection: Ascending video archive byte size, then video ID; first four sources with one eligible positive and one eligible negative track. Select by timestamps and published labels, never model outcomes. Minimum native crop side 64 pixels, continuous 100-frame context, 25 stable-label target frames beginning 37 frames into context.
restoration: Official Ear-for-Face-SR released weights applied independently to frames; fixed four-second source soundtrack for all target frames. This is framewise restoration, not a trained temporal model.
donor_rule: Next selected source cyclically, its positive track context; identical for both tracks of a source. No donor selected using outcomes.
downstream: Official TalkNet TalkSet checkpoint, V head before cross-attention and AV head with identical original one-second audio in every condition; threshold 0.5.
quality: Per-frame SSIM and PSNR against the unmodified face crop resized to 128; degraded bicubic and visual-only restoration are explicit baselines.
RQ1_event: At least five target frames in a track where reference, degraded and matching AV predictions are correct, swapped AV is wrong, swapped wrong-class softmax increases at least 0.10 versus matching, and swapped SSIM exceeds degraded SSIM. Report both false positives and misses; require at least two independent source videos for a positive pilot screen.
RQ2: Compare native 8x8 versus effective 4x4 with fixed visual arrays and audio intervention. Attribute downstream changes to audio only after exact repeat and fixed downstream A-head checks; pixel change alone is insufficient.
RQ3: Predefined rankings: audio-conditioning score sensitivity, disagreement with degraded-video scores, low-resolution re-degradation residual, and model confidence. Compare selective error at identical 50% and 75% frame coverage. Also report degraded/visual-only/full-coverage and abstain-all. No tuning. A positive safeguard screen requires lower pooled AV error than confidence at both coverages and a reduction at 75% in at least two sources.
repeat: Recompute first matching target frame for every track and degradation; deterministic noise-disabled generator.
statistics: Descriptive source-level pilot, four sources; no frame-independent significance claims. Scores are uncalibrated softmax, not probability of correctness. Report all selected cases including failures.
decision: GO for a bounded follow-up only if the RQ1 two-source screen and the RQ3 safeguard screen both pass; otherwise NO-GO for scaling this tested setup. This does not establish or falsify all audio-conditioned restorers.
